rules.hint: Open the hospital_course narrative with the exact header 'Hospital course summary:' followed by one space. Break sentences with newlines.
rules.example_before: Hospital course summary: The patient was admitted for enteric fever (typhoid) with fever spikes. Blood cultures from admission were positive for Salmonella Typhi, which was sensitive to ceftriaxone. T
rules.example_after:
Hospital course summary: The patient was admitted for enteric fever (typhoid) with fever spikes.
Blood cultures from admission were positive for Salmonella Typhi, which was sensitive to ceftriaxone.
T

rules.hint: For section 'discharge_medications', match the reviewer's phrasing exactly when evidence permits.
rules.example_before: DOLO-650 650mg SOS | PANTOPRAZOLE 40mg OD | ONDANSETRON 4mg SOS | VITAMIN C 500mg OD | CARIPAPIL 1 tab TID | LIV-52 2 tsp BID
rules.example_after: paracetamol (Dolo-650) 650mg SOS | PANTOPRAZOLE 40mg OD | ONDANSETRON 4mg SOS | VITAMIN C 500mg OD | CARIPAPIL 1 tab TID | LIV-52 2 tsp BID

rules.hint: When writing medication entries, render brand-only names as '<generic> (<Brand>)' — e.g. 'TAB RACIPER' → 'rabeprazole (Raciper)'.
rules.example_before: AZITHRAL 500mg 1-0-0 | PAN 40mg 1-0-0 | DOLO 650mg SOS | EMSET 4mg SOS
rules.example_after: azithromycin (Azithral) 500mg 1-0-0 | pantoprazole (Pan) 40mg 1-0-0 | paracetamol (Dolo) 650mg SOS | EMSET 4mg SOS

rules.hint: Render pending results with explicit date suffix: '<test> (pending as of <discharge_date>)'.
